MODE 6-2: Run

Execute the program stored in a selected slot.

keys
MODE→6→2

MODE 6 → 2 → slot. Respond to ? prompts with values then EXE. Display pauses (◢) wait for EXE to continue.

Example

  1. MODE → 6 → 2 → 1 runs P1.
